feature_definitions.StockMom60_raw: existing res60s1 raw primitive before centered_rank: residual=raw_return-beta*TOPIX, shift1 within segment, rolling60 observations min60 sum, >20 absent exchange-date gap reset
feature_definitions.Sector33Common_raw: same-date PIT33 equal mean of finite StockMom60_raw INCLUDING own if finite, minimum5 finite members, broadcast exactly same raw value to every sector member present that date
feature_definitions.PIT: Date/Code exact left join, missing/9999/blank excluded, only raw_return rows present on signal date enter daily membership; no latest/future/backfill
feature_definitions.missing: undefined raw component stays NaN for raw coverage; each raw component independently neutral0 BEFORE EWMA; no history carry imputation or arbitrary state reset
feature_definitions.EWMA: same per-Code/relisting-segment smooth primitive as existing MOM60; alpha .25, adjust=False. Sector changes keep previous Code state, no extra reset. Current sector raw common equal; smoothed histories can differ for sector changers/new/relisted stocks.
feature_definitions.Z: same-date arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof1) of finite smoothed scores across all required date-present stock rows; zero SD -> neutral0; no winsorization/rank/sector weighting
feature_definitions.combined: Z(EWMA(SectorCommon raw neutral0)) + Z(EWMA(Within raw neutral0)); exactly1:1, NO additional EWMA after date-zscore
feature_definitions.identity: raw on joint finite rows; smoothed Stock(raw neutral0) vs Sector/Within. Independent neutralization can break identity on missing histories; defect=Stock0-Sector0-Within0. Test discrepancy equals EWMA(defect) within floating tolerance. No economic definition altered to hide mismatch.

model: Fixed common/within decomposition, same causal EWMA and equal standardized combination. No labels, fitted model, horizons, weights or smoothing search.
selection_rule: All3 evaluated regardless feasibility. A/B are component identification only: REJECT if feasibility fails, DESCRIPTIVE_COMPONENT_ONLY if all pass; no standalone adoption/rescue. COMBINED next-stage eligibility requires feasibility AND pooled/ex2016 NetSR>MOM60, full-year2011-2015 improvement>=4/5, paired bootstrap deltaNetSR lower>0, annualNet>MOM60, turnover<=MOM60*1.25, annualShortgross/net>=MOM60, positive Q monotonicity. Else REJECT. No added positive-Short requirement beyond user inequalities. No release/Valid.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block of matched eligible sessions, percentile95% deltaNetSR

diagnostics.ties: all4 official scores, daily unique score count; exact tie share=rows in duplicate same-date values/N; same-sector Q1/Q5 exposure; within-exact-tie ordinal Code/rank and actual tail membership; ONE tiny deterministic perturbation score-1e-12*max(1,date maxabs(score))*same-date centered Code rank. Only Q1/Q5 migration/Jaccard and weight change, NO perturbation P/L/selection/random search. Report changed non-tied order too.
diagnostics.rank_changes: adjacent exchange-date percentile rank change distribution, daily/fold pooled; retention and full tail spells, censored/gap conventions documented
diagnostics.common_alpha: same-date sector equal-stock average raw/smoothed common and target; finite count and dispersion; low/middle/high sector-rank thirds fixed diagnostic; sector P/L attribution from original book
diagnostics.within_alpha: within each PIT sector/date smoothedWithin RankIC/HAC5, descriptive internal Q1-Q5 target means using deterministic Code ties; original global-book Long/Short contributions, no new portfolio
diagnostics.agreement: A(++),B(+-),C(-+),D(--),ZERO_OR_MISSING raw signs, target mean + stock/sector/within RankIC/HAC; original MOM60 and COMBINED Long/Short/gross/net attribution, no filters
diagnostics.concentration: 33 only all4, daily exposure/HHI/max weight/Q1Q5 distribution, annual contributions/top2; LOSO subtract original sector P/L and attributed costs, NO rerank/renormalization
diagnostics.Short: gross/net Sharpe/annual P/L and turnover costs per side; delta net=delta gross-delta cost against MOM60
